metadata.description: A curated marketplace of Claude Code plugins for AWS development — skills, sub-agents, and MCP servers for building on AWS.

plugins.name: aws-dev-toolkit
plugins.description: [DEPRECATED] AWS Dev Toolkit is no longer maintained. Startup-specific guidance is available in AWS Startup Advisor; install aws-startup-advisor@claude-plugins-official. For general-purpose AWS guidance, use Agent Toolkit for AWS (aws configure agent-toolkit). This AWS Dev Toolkit plugin will stop receiving updates and will be removed from the marketplace. Existing installs continue to function during the transition; install AWS Startup Advisor to keep receiving startup guidance.
